name: Jupiter
blessing_text: Jupiter is pleased: Rome looks on the city with favor.
wrath_text: Jupiter hurls a thunderbolt: a building is struck by lightning!

name: Juno
blessing_text: Juno blesses the city's families: many children are born.
wrath_text: Juno is displeased: few children are born this season.

name: Mars
blessing_text: Mars favors your soldiers: morale and training soar.
wrath_text: Mars is angry: soldiers desert their posts.

name: Venus
blessing_text: Venus smiles on the city: the people are glad.
wrath_text: Venus sends a plague of discontent.

name: Ceres
wrath_text: Ceres sends blight: the fields wither.

name: Neptune
blessing_text: Neptune calms the seas: ships sail safely and fish abound.

name: Mercury
blessing_text: Mercury guides the merchants: trade prices improve.
wrath_text: Mercury turns away: merchants shun the city.

name: Minerva
wrath_text: Minerva's anger causes accidents in the workshops.

name: Vulcan
blessing_text: Vulcan tames the flames: fires are rare.

name: Vesta
blessing_text: Vesta warms every hearth: households are content.
wrath_text: Vesta's hearth fires spread to the houses!

name: Divus Augustus
blessing_text: The divine Emperor is honoured: favor grows.
wrath_text: The Imperial cult is neglected: Rome takes note.
